name: Chemyx Fusion 100 syringe pump
roles: Pump A — All Stage 1 reagents are mutually compatible and dissolved together in 2-MeTHF as a single homogeneous feed, matching the batch protocol where all three solids are combined before solvent addition. Single-pump delivery simplifies the setup and avoids stoichiometry drift.

Pump B — Benzylamine is introduced as a separate stream at the T-junction between Stage 1 and Stage 2 reactors. Concentration is set so that the volumetric ratio of Stream B to Stream A gives the correct 1.05 equiv stoichiometry and achieves the batch Stage 2 dilution (0.40 M effective substrate concentration). Stream B flow = 0.25 × Stream A flow.
